1.english_reference: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD

traditions.WLC: הַ דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֤ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ מֵ אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Ὁ λόγος ὁ γενόμενος παρὰ Κυρίου πρὸς Ἰερεμίαν
traditions.VUL: Sermo , qui factus est ad Ieremíam a Dómino ,
traditions.KJV: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD ,

1.english_reference: after that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah

traditions.WLC: אַחַ֣ר שַׁלַּ֣ח אֹת֗ וֹ נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֛ן רַב טַבָּחִ֖ים מִן הָֽ רָמָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: μετὰ τὸ ἀποστεῖλαι αὐτὸν Ναβουζαρδὰν τὸν ἀρχιμάγειρον τὸν ἐκ Δαμάν ,
traditions.VUL: postquam dimíssus est a Nabuzárdan magístro milítiæ de Rama ,
traditions.KJV: after that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah ,

1.english_reference: when he had taken him being bound in chains

traditions.WLC: בְּ קַחְתּ֣ וֹ אֹת֗ וֹ וְ הֽוּא אָס֤וּר בָּֽ אזִקִּים֙
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ λαβεῖν αὐτὸν ἐν χειροπέδαις
traditions.VUL: quando tulit eum vinctum caténis
traditions.KJV: when he had taken him being bound in chains

1.english_reference: among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah

traditions.WLC: בְּ ת֨וֹךְ כָּל גָּל֤וּת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וִֽ יהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ἐν μέσῳ ἀποικίας Ἰούδα
traditions.VUL: in médio ómnium , qui migrábant de Ierúsalem et Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah ,

1.english_reference: which were carried away captive unto Babylon

traditions.WLC: הַ מֻּגְלִ֖ים בָּבֶֽלָ ה
traditions.LXX: τῶν ἠγμένων εἰς Βαβυλῶνα .
traditions.VUL: et ducebántur in Babylónem .
traditions.KJV: which were carried away captive unto Babylon .

2.english_reference: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקַּ֥ח רַב טַבָּחִ֖ים לְ יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὸν ὁ ἀρχιμάγειρος
traditions.VUL: Tollens ergo princeps milítiæ Ieremíam ,
traditions.KJV: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah ,

2.english_reference: and said unto him , The LORD thy God hath pronounced this evil upon this place

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י ו יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י ךָ דִּבֶּר֙ אֶת הָ רָעָ֣ה הַ זֹּ֔את אֶל הַ מָּק֖וֹם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐλάλησεν τὰ κακὰ ταῦτα ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον τοῦτον ,
traditions.VUL: dixit ad eum : Dóminus Deus tuus locútus est malum hoc super locum istum :
traditions.KJV: and said unto him , The LORD thy God hath pronounced this evil upon this place .

3.english_reference: Now the LORD hath brought [ it ] , and done according as he hath said

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֵ֥א וַ יַּ֛עַשׂ יְהוָ֖ה כַּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: et addúxit , et fecit Dóminus sicut locútus est ,
traditions.KJV: Now the LORD hath brought [ it ] , and done according as he hath said :

3.english_reference: because ye have sinned against the LORD , and have not obeyed his voice

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי חֲטָאתֶ֤ם לַֽ יהוָה֙ וְ לֹֽא שְׁמַעְתֶּ֣ם בְּ קוֹל֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἡμάρτετε αὐτῷ καὶ οὐκ ἠκούσατε αὐτοῦ τῆς φωνῆς .
traditions.VUL: quia peccástis Dómino , et non audístis vocem eius :
traditions.KJV: because ye have sinned against the LORD , and have not obeyed his voice ,

3.english_reference: therefore this thing is come upon you

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָ֥ה לָ כֶ֖ם דבר הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.VUL: et factus est vobis sermo hic .
traditions.KJV: therefore this thing is come upon you .

4.english_reference: And now , behold , I loose thee this day from the chains which [ were ] upon thine hand

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֞ה הִנֵּ֧ה פִתַּחְתִּ֣י ךָ הַ יּ֗וֹם מִֽן הָ אזִקִּים֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל יָדֶ ךָ֒
traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ ἔλυσά σε ἀπὸ τῶν χειροπέδων τῶν ἐπὶ τὰς χεῖράς σου ·
traditions.VUL: Nunc ergo ecce solvi te hódie de caténis , quæ sunt in mánibus tuis :
traditions.KJV: And now , behold , I loose thee this day from the chains which [ were ] upon thine hand .

4.english_reference: If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon , come

traditions.WLC: אִם ט֨וֹב בְּ עֵינֶ֜י ךָ לָ ב֧וֹא אִתִּ֣ י בָבֶ֗ל בֹּ֚א
traditions.LXX: εἰ καλὸν ἐναντίον σου ἐλθεῖν μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ εἰς Βαβυλῶνα ,
traditions.VUL: si placet tibi ut vénias mecum in Babylónem , veni :
traditions.KJV: If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon , come ;

4.english_reference: and I will look well unto thee

traditions.WLC: וְ אָשִׂ֤ים אֶת עֵינִ י֙ עָלֶ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ θήσω τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου ἐπὶ σέ ·
traditions.VUL: et ponam óculos meos super te :
traditions.KJV: and I will look well unto thee :

4.english_reference: but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon , forbear

traditions.WLC: וְ אִם רַ֧ע בְּ עֵינֶ֛י ךָ לָ בֽוֹא אִתִּ֥ י בָבֶ֖ל חֲדָ֑ל
traditions.VUL: si autem dísplicet tibi veníre mecum in Babylónem , réside :
traditions.KJV: but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon , forbear :

4.english_reference: behold , all the land [ is ] before thee

traditions.WLC: רְאֵה֙ כָּל הָ אָ֣רֶץ לְ פָנֶ֔י ךָ
traditions.VUL: ecce omnis terra in conspéctu tuo est :
traditions.KJV: behold , all the land [ is ] before thee :

4.english_reference: whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go , thither go

traditions.WLC: אֶל ט֨וֹב וְ אֶל הַ יָּשָׁ֧ר בְּ עֵינֶ֛י ךָ לָ לֶ֥כֶת שָׁ֖מָּ ה לֵֽךְ
traditions.VUL: quod elégeris , et quo placúerit tibi ut vadas , illuc perge .
traditions.KJV: whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go , thither go .

5.english_reference: Now while he was not yet gone back , [ he said ] , Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan

traditions.WLC: וְ עוֹדֶ֣ נּוּ לֹֽא יָשׁ֗וּב וְ שֻׁ֡בָ ה אֶל גְּדַלְיָ֣ה בֶן אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן שָׁפָ֡ן
traditions.LXX: εἰ δὲ μή , ἀπότρεχε , ἀνάστρεψον πρὸς τὸν Γοδολίαν υἱὸν Ἀχεικὰμ υἱοῦ Σαφάν ,
traditions.VUL: Et mecum noli veníre , sed hábita apud Godolíam fílium Ahicam fílii Saphan ,
traditions.KJV: Now while he was not yet gone back , [ he said ] , Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan ,

5.english_reference: whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר֩ הִפְקִ֨יד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֜ל בְּ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: ὃν κατέστησεν βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος ἐν γῇ Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: quem præpósuit rex Babylónis civitátibus Iuda :
traditions.KJV: whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah ,

5.english_reference: and dwell with him among the people

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁ֤ב אִתּ וֹ֙ בְּ ת֣וֹךְ הָ עָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἴκησον μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ λαοῦ ἐν γῇ Ἰούδα ·
traditions.VUL: hábita ergo cum eo in médio pópuli :
traditions.KJV: and dwell with him among the people :

5.english_reference: or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go

traditions.WLC: א֠וֹ אֶל כָּל הַ יָּשָׁ֧ר בְּ עֵינֶ֛י ךָ לָ לֶ֖כֶת לֵ֑ךְ
traditions.LXX: εἰς ἅπαντα τὰ ἀγαθὰ ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου τοῦ πορευθῆναι , πορεύου .
traditions.VUL: vel quocúmque placúerit tibi ut vadas , vade .
traditions.KJV: or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go .

5.english_reference: So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward , and let him go

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתֶּן ל֧ וֹ רַב טַבָּחִ֛ים אֲרֻחָ֥ה וּ מַשְׂאֵ֖ת וַֽ יְשַׁלְּחֵֽ הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ ἀρχιμάγειρος δῶρα καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτόν .
traditions.VUL: Dedit quoque ei magíster milítiæ cibária et munúscula , et dimísit eum .
traditions.KJV: So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward , and let him go .

6.english_reference: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֧א יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ אֶל גְּדַלְיָ֥ה בֶן אֲחִיקָ֖ם הַ מִּצְפָּ֑תָ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς Γοδολίαν εἰς Μασσηφά ,
traditions.VUL: Venit autem Ieremías ad Godolíam fílium Ahicam in Masphath ,
traditions.KJV: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah ;

6.english_reference: and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֤שֶׁב אִתּ וֹ֙ בְּ ת֣וֹךְ הָ עָ֔ם הַ נִּשְׁאָרִ֖ים בָּ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ λαοῦ τοῦ καταλειφθέντος ἐν τῇ γῇ .
traditions.VUL: et habitávit cum eo in médio pópuli , qui relíctus fúerat in terra .
traditions.KJV: and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land .

7.english_reference: Now when all the captains of the forces which [ were ] in the fields , [ even ] they and their men , heard

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁמְעוּ֩ כָל שָׂרֵ֨י הַ חֲיָלִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ שָּׂדֶ֗ה הֵ֚מָּה וְ אַנְשֵׁי הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἤκουσαν πάντες οἱ ἡγεμόνες τῆς δυνάμεως τῆς ἐν ἀγρῷ , αὐτοὶ καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque audíssent omnes príncipes exércitus , qui dispérsi fúerant per regiónes , ipsi et sócii eórum ,
traditions.KJV: Now when all the captains of the forces which [ were ] in the fields , [ even ] they and their men , heard

7.english_reference: that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי הִפְקִ֧יד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֥הוּ בֶן אֲחִיקָ֖ם בָּ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι κατέστησεν βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος τὸν Γοδολίαν ἐν τῇ γῇ ,
traditions.VUL: quod præfecísset rex Babylónis Godolíam fílium Ahicam terræ ,
traditions.KJV: that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land ,

7.english_reference: and had committed unto him men , and women , and children , and of the poor of the land

traditions.WLC: וְ כִ֣י הִפְקִ֣יד אִתּ֗ וֹ אֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְ נָשִׁים֙ וָ טָ֔ף וּ מִ דַּלַּ֣ת הָ אָ֔רֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρεκατέθεντο αὐτῷ ἄνδρας καὶ γυναῖκας αὐτῶν
traditions.VUL: et quod commendásset ei viros , et mulíeres , et párvulos , et de paupéribus terræ ,
traditions.KJV: and had committed unto him men , and women , and children , and of the poor of the land ,

7.english_reference: of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon

traditions.WLC: מֵ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא הָגְל֖וּ בָּבֶֽלָ ה
traditions.LXX: οὓς οὐκ ἀπῴκισεν εἰς Βαβυλῶνα .
traditions.VUL: qui non fúerant transláti in Babylónem :
traditions.KJV: of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon ;

8.english_reference: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל גְּדַלְיָ֖ה הַ מִּצְפָּ֑תָ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς Γοδολίαν εἰς Μασσηφὰ
traditions.VUL: venérunt ad Godolíam in Masphath :
traditions.KJV: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah ,

8.english_reference: even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah , and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth , and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite , and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite

traditions.WLC: וְ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֡הוּ וְ יוֹחָנָ֣ן וְ יוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנֵֽי קָ֠רֵחַ וּ שְׂרָיָ֨ה בֶן תַּנְחֻ֜מֶת וּ בְנֵ֣י עופי הַ נְּטֹפָתִ֗י וִֽ יזַנְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן הַ מַּ֣עֲכָתִ֔י
traditions.LXX: Ἰσμαὴλ υἱὸς Ναθανίου καὶ Ἰωνὰν υἱὸς Καρῆε καὶ Σαραιὰ υἱὸς Θαναέμαιθ καὶ υἱοὶ Ἰωφὲ τοῦ Νετωφατεὶ καὶ Ἰεζονίας υἱὸς τοῦ Μοχατεί ,
traditions.VUL: et Ismahel fílius Nathaníæ , et Ióhanan , et Iónathan fílii Carée , et Saréas fílius Thanéhumeth , et fílii Ophi , qui erant de Netóphathi , et Iezonías fílius Maáchathi ,
traditions.KJV: even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah , and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth , and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite , and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite ,

traditions.WLC: הֵ֖מָּה וְ אַנְשֵׁי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: αὐτοὶ καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: ipsi et viri eórum .
traditions.KJV: they and their men .

9.english_reference: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men , saying

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשָּׁבַ֨ע לָ הֶ֜ם גְּדַלְיָ֨הוּ בֶן אֲחִיקָ֤ם בֶּן שָׁפָן֙ וּ לְ אַנְשֵׁי הֶ֣ם לֵ אמֹ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὤμοσεν αὐτοῖς Γοδολίας καὶ τοῖς ἀνδράσιν αὐτῶν λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et iurávit eis Godolías fílius Ahicam fílii Saphan , et comítibus eórum , dicens :
traditions.KJV: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men , saying ,

9.english_reference: Fear not to serve the Chaldeans

traditions.WLC: אַל תִּֽירְא֖וּ מֵ עֲב֣וֹד הַ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: Μὴ φοβηθῆτε ἀπὸ προσώπου παίδων τῶν Χαλδαίων ·
traditions.VUL: Nolíte timére servíre Chaldǽis :
traditions.KJV: Fear not to serve the Chaldeans :

9.english_reference: dwell in the land , and serve the king of Babylon

traditions.WLC: שְׁב֣וּ בָ אָ֗רֶץ וְ עִבְד֛וּ אֶת מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל
traditions.LXX: κατοικήσατε ἐν τῇ γῇ καὶ ἐργάσασθε τῷ βασιλεῖ Βαβυλῶνος ,
traditions.VUL: habitáte in terra , et servíte regi Babylónis ,
traditions.KJV: dwell in the land , and serve the king of Babylon ,

9.english_reference: and it shall be well with you

traditions.WLC: וְ יִיטַ֥ב לָ כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ βέλτιον ἔσται ὑμῖν .
traditions.VUL: et bene erit vobis .
traditions.KJV: and it shall be well with you .

10.english_reference: As for me , behold , I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans , which will come unto us

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנִ֗י הִנְ נִ֤י יֹשֵׁב֙ בַּ מִּצְפָּ֔ה לַֽ עֲמֹד֙ לִ פְנֵ֣י הַ כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֖אוּ אֵלֵ֑י נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ κάθημαι ἐναντίον ὑμῶν εἰς Μασσηφὰ στῆναι κατὰ πρόσωπον τῶν Χαλδαίων οἳ ἂν ἔλθωσιν ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς ·
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego hábito in Masphath , ut respóndeam præcépto Chaldæórum , qui mittúntur ad nos :
traditions.KJV: As for me , behold , I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans , which will come unto us :

10.english_reference: but ye , gather ye wine , and summer fruits , and oil

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתֶּ֡ם אִסְפוּ֩ יַ֨יִן וְ קַ֜יִץ וְ שֶׁ֗מֶן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑμεῖς συναγάγετε οἶνον καὶ ὀπώραν καὶ ἔλαιον ,
traditions.VUL: vos autem collígite vindémiam , et messem , et óleum ,
traditions.KJV: but ye , gather ye wine , and summer fruits , and oil ,

10.english_reference: and put [ them ] in your vessels

traditions.WLC: וְ שִׂ֨מוּ֙ בִּ כְלֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ βάλετε εἰς τὰ ἀγγεῖα ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et cóndite in vasis vestris ,
traditions.KJV: and put [ them ] in your vessels ,

10.english_reference: and dwell in your cities that ye have taken

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁב֖וּ בְּ עָרֵי כֶ֥ם אֲשֶׁר תְּפַשְׂתֶּֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἰκήσατε ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν αἷς κατεκρατήσατε .
traditions.VUL: et manéte in úrbibus vestris , quas tenétis .
traditions.KJV: and dwell in your cities that ye have taken .

11.english_reference: Likewise when all the Jews that [ were ] in Moab , and among the Ammonites , and in Edom , and that [ were ] in all the countries , heard

traditions.WLC: וְ גַ֣ם כָּֽל הַ יְּהוּדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר בְּ מוֹאָ֣ב וּ בִ בְנֵֽי עַמּ֨וֹן וּ בֶ אֱד֜וֹם וַ אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּ כָל הָֽ אֲרָצוֹת֙ שָֽׁמְע֔וּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάντες οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι οἱ ἐν Μωὰβ καὶ ἐν υἱοῖς Ἀμμὼν καὶ οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἰδουμαίᾳ καὶ οἱ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ ἤκουσαν
traditions.VUL: Sed et omnes Iudǽi , qui erant in Moab , et in fíliis Ammon , et in Idumǽa , et in univérsis regiónibus , audíto
traditions.KJV: Likewise when all the Jews that [ were ] in Moab , and among the Ammonites , and in Edom , and that [ were ] in all the countries , heard

11.english_reference: that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah ,

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי נָתַ֧ן מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל שְׁאֵרִ֖ית לִֽ יהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἔδωκεν βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος κατάλιμμα τῷ Ἰούδᾳ ,
traditions.VUL: quod dedísset rex Babylónis relíquias in Iudǽa ,
traditions.KJV: that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah ,

11.english_reference: and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan ;

traditions.WLC: וְ כִי֙ הִפְקִ֣יד עֲלֵי הֶ֔ם אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן אֲחִיקָ֥ם בֶּן שָׁפָֽן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὅτι κατέστησεν ἐπ᾽ αὐτοὺς τὸν Γοδολίαν υἱὸν Ἀχεικάμ .
traditions.VUL: et quod præposuísset super eos Godolíam fílium Ahicam fílii Saphan :
traditions.KJV: and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan ;

12.english_reference: Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּשֻׁ֣בוּ כָל הַ יְּהוּדִ֗ים מִ כָּל הַ מְּקֹמוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִדְּחוּ שָׁ֔ם
traditions.VUL: revérsi sunt , inquam , omnes Iudǽi de univérsis locis , ad quæ profúgerant ,
traditions.KJV: Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven ,

12.english_reference: and came to the land of Judah , to Gedaliah , unto Mizpah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶֽרֶץ יְהוּדָ֛ה אֶל גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ הַ מִּצְפָּ֑תָ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς Γοδολίαν εἰς γῆν Ἰούδα εἰς Μασσηφά ,
traditions.VUL: et venérunt in terram Iuda ad Godolíam in Masphath ,
traditions.KJV: and came to the land of Judah , to Gedaliah , unto Mizpah ,

12.english_reference: and gathered wine and summer fruits very much .

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּאַסְפ֛וּ יַ֥יִן וָ קַ֖יִץ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνήγαγον οἶνον καὶ ὀπώραν πολλὴν σφόδρα καὶ ἔλαιον .
traditions.VUL: et collegérunt vinum et messem multam nimis .
traditions.KJV: and gathered wine and summer fruits very much .

13.english_reference: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that [ were ] in the fields ,

traditions.WLC: וְ יֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּן קָרֵ֔חַ וְ כָל שָׂרֵ֥י הַ חֲיָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ שָּׂדֶ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Καὶ Ἰωανὰν υἱὸς Καρῆε καὶ πάντες οἱ ἡγεμόνες τῆς δυνάμεως οἱ ἐν τοῖς ἀγροῖς
traditions.VUL: Ióhanan autem fílius Carée , et omnes príncipes exércitus , qui dispérsi fúerant in regiónibus ,
traditions.KJV: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that [ were ] in the fields ,

traditions.WLC: בָּ֥אוּ אֶל גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ הַ מִּצְפָּֽתָ ה
traditions.LXX: ἦλθον πρὸς τὸν Γοδολίαν εἰς Μασσηφὰ
traditions.VUL: venérunt ad Godolíam in Masphath ,
traditions.KJV: came to Gedaliah to Mizpah ,

14.english_reference: And said unto him , Dost thou certainly know

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗י ו הֲ יָדֹ֤עַ תֵּדַע֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Εἰ γνώσει γινώσκεις
traditions.VUL: et dixérunt ei : Scito
traditions.KJV: And said unto him , Dost thou certainly know

14.english_reference: that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee ?

traditions.WLC: כִּ֞י בַּעֲלִ֣יס מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵֽי עַמּ֗וֹן שָׁלַח֙ אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֔ה לְ הַכֹּתְ ךָ֖ נָ֑פֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι Βελεισὰ βασιλεὺς υἱῶν Ἀμμὼν ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς σὲ τὸν Ἰσμαὴλ πατάξαι σου ψυχήν ?
traditions.VUL: quod Báalis rex filiórum Ammon misit Ismahel fílium Nathaníæ percútere ánimam tuam .
traditions.KJV: that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee ?

14.english_reference: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not .

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא הֶאֱמִ֣ין לָ הֶ֔ם גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן אֲחִיקָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐπίστευσεν αὐτοῖς Γοδολίας .
traditions.VUL: Et non crédidit eis Godolías fílius Ahicam .
traditions.KJV: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not .

15.english_reference: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וְ יוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן קָרֵ֡חַ אָמַ֣ר אֶל גְּדַלְיָהוּ֩ בַ סֵּ֨תֶר בַּ מִּצְפָּ֜ה לֵ אמֹ֗ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰωανὰν εἶπεν τῷ Γοδολίᾳ κρυφαίως ἐν Μασσηθά
traditions.VUL: Ióhanan autem fílius Carée dixit ad Godolíam seórsum in Masphath , loquens :
traditions.KJV: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly , saying ,

15.english_reference: Let me go , I pray thee , and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah ,

traditions.WLC: אֵ֤לְכָה נָּא֙ וְ אַכֶּה֙ אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Πορεύσομαι δὴ καὶ πατάξω τὸν Ἰσμαήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Ibo , et percútiam Ismahel fílium Nathaníæ ,
traditions.KJV: Let me go , I pray thee , and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah ,

15.english_reference: and no man shall know [ it ] :

traditions.WLC: וְ אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע
traditions.LXX: καὶ μηθεὶς γνώτω ,
traditions.VUL: nullo sciénte ,
traditions.KJV: and no man shall know [ it ] :

traditions.WLC: לָ֧ מָּה יַכֶּ֣ כָּה נֶּ֗פֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: μὴ πατάξῃ σου ψυχὴν
traditions.VUL: ne interfíciat ánimam tuam ,
traditions.KJV: wherefore should he slay thee ,

15.english_reference: that all the Jews which are gathered unto thee should be scattered ,

traditions.WLC: וְ נָפֹ֨צוּ֙ כָּל יְהוּדָ֔ה הַ נִּקְבָּצִ֣ים אֵלֶ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ διασπαρῇ πᾶς Ἰουδὰ οἱ συνηγμένοι πρὸς σὲ
traditions.VUL: et dissipéntur omnes Iudǽi , qui congregáti sunt ad te ,
traditions.KJV: that all the Jews which are gathered unto thee should be scattered ,

15.english_reference: and the remnant in Judah perish ?

traditions.WLC: וְ אָבְדָ֖ה שְׁאֵרִ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπολοῦνται οἱ κατάλοιποι Ἰούδα .
traditions.VUL: et períbunt relíquiæ Iuda .
traditions.KJV: and the remnant in Judah perish ?

16.english_reference: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר גְּדַלְיָ֤הוּ בֶן אֲחִיקָם֙ אֶל יוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן קָרֵ֔חַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Γοδολίας πρὸς Ἰωανάν
traditions.VUL: Et ait Godolías fílius Ahicam ad Ióhanan fílium Carée :
traditions.KJV: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah ,

16.english_reference: Thou shalt not do this thing :

traditions.WLC: אַֽל תעש אֶת הַ דָּבָ֣ר הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Μὴ ποιήσῃς τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο ,
traditions.VUL: Noli fácere verbum hoc :
traditions.KJV: Thou shalt not do this thing :

16.english_reference: for thou speakest falsely of Ishmael .

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי שֶׁ֛קֶר אַתָּ֥ה דֹבֵ֖ר אֶל יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ψευδῆ σὺ λέγεις ὑπὲρ Ἰσμαήλ .
traditions.VUL: falsum enim tu lóqueris de Ismahel .
traditions.KJV: for thou speakest falsely of Ishmael .
